title: ECMWF IFS ENS Weather Model Historical Archive
description: Archive of grib2 files containing selected variables from ECMWF IFS ENS. This dataset is currently being backfilled. A cloud optimized version of these data are available at https://dynamical.org/catalog/ecmwf-ifs-ens-forecast-15-day-0-25-degree/ and https://source.coop/dynamical/ecmwf-ifs-ens-forecast-15-day-0-25-degree.
